 “ Off Campus ” has officially set its Season 2 premiere date at Amazon Prime Video . 
 The second season of the popular YA drama will debut April 28, 2027. As previously announced, the second season will focus on the relationship between Allie Hayes (Mika Abdalla) and Dean Di Laurentis (Stephen Kalyn). 
 Based on Elle Kennedy’s “Off Campus” book series, the Prime Video show originally debuted in May 2026. Per Amazon, the show reached 36 million viewers worldwide in its first 12 days of availability, though how they define reach remains unclear. It is also Amazon’s most-viewed series debut season of all time.

 The official logline states that the show “follows an elite ice hockey team, and the women in their lives, as they grapple with love, heartbreak, and self-discovery—forging deep friendships and enduring bonds while navigating the complexities that come with transitioning into adulthood.” 
 Along with Abdalla and Kalyn, the cast of the series includes: Ella Bright, Belmont Cameli, Antonio Cipriano, Jalen Thomas Brooks, India Fowler, with Julia Sarah-Stone, Khobe Clarke, Miles Gutierrez-Riley, and Philipa Soo set to recur. Charlie Evans and Shay Rudolph will guest star.
 Louisa Levy adapted the books for the screen and serves as co-showrunner and executive producer alongside Gina Fattore. Wyck Godfrey, Marty Bowen and James Seidman executive produce via Temple Hill, with Leanna Billings of Billings Productions and Neal Flaherty also executive producing. Annika Patton of Temple Hill co-executive produces. 
 The first season of “Off Campus” proved to be a hit with critics as well as audiences, with the season holding a 92% critical approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes. In her review for Variety , Aramide Tinubu wrote, “‘Off Campus’ is mostly solid, and Bright and Cameli have lovely chemistry, as do side characters who get their own moments to shine. The series also does a great job highlighting discussions of sexual assault and consent while showcasing healthy sexual encounters and practices.”
